title: New Kaiju No. 8 Anime Short Unveils Story, Staff, Fall Debut
content: The staff for the new anime short of Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga presented its main visual and announced its story, staff, and the returning lead cast member on Saturday. "Narumi's Week at Work" ("Narumi no Heijitsu") will debut this fall with a story conceived by the Kaiju No.
author: ANN

title: Kaiju No. 8: Narumi's Week at Work Anime Reveals Main Visual, Fall 2026 Release
content: Kaiju No. 8: Narumi’s Week at Work original short anime revealed the main visual, as well as a Fall 2026 release date. The anime was announced alongside with the final arc of the mainline TV anime. Studio Production I.G is animating again, with Studio Khara back in charge of the creature designs.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Grotesqqque' Announces Cast Members
content: Production company Aniplex opened an official website for the Grotesqqque original anime movie on Saturday, revealing the cast members. The anime movie, originally scheduled to air in 2025, is now planned for a 2026 premiere.
author: MyAnimeList

title: CloverWorks' Original Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Reveals 14 Cast Members
content: Anime studio CloverWorks revealed on Saturday the cast and characters for its original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque ). CloverWorks revealed the cast and character names, but did not state which person was voicing which character.
author: ANN

author: ANN

title: Every New Anime Coming to Netflix in June 2026
content: Netflix is all set for its June calendar and has quite an exciting list of anime coming to the platform for the first time. While there are only two new anime series being added to the platform this month, Netflix confirmed the return of some of the biggest anime ever.
author: ComicBook

title: 35 Years Later, Legendary Creator’s Forgotten Series Confirms an Official New Release
content: The anime and manga industry is growing ever so rapidly, which also means that the older series eventually get forgotten over time, especially if they don’t keep returning with new releases. However, there’s always an exception to the rule, especially if the anime or the manga is well-received by fans.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Acclaimed Shonen Jump Original Returns With an Anticipated Release
content: Despite the numerous hiatuses and the anime’s discontinuation, D.Gray-man still maintains a dedicated fan base thanks to its brilliant world-building, unique power system, stellar art, and a thrilling story.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Apologizes As Final Message to Fans
content: Thanks to the success of several long-running classics such as Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , etc., Weekly Shonen Jump became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Launched in 1968, the magazine has serialized countless incredible manga series and one-shots over the decades.
author: ComicBook

title: 8 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Major Shonen jump Series Unveils First Look At Finale
content: Based on the award-winning Shonen manga written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, Dr. Stone ’s anime adaptation is all set for its finale in a few weeks. The anime returns with part 3 of its final season in April, as part of the Spring 2026 lineup.
author: ComicBook
